votes.motion: Ratify the Town Manager's appointment of Stephen Wallace as Director of Planning and Economic Development
votes.quote: motion by chair nuzzolo to ratify the town manager's appointment of stephen wallace as director of planning and economic development. seconded by clerk renee emkey. call for vote: four- aye. the motion passed unanimously (4-0-0).

votes.motion: Ratify the Town Manager's appointment of Brandie O'Toole as Meal Site Manager
votes.quote: motion by chair nuzzolo to ratify the town manager's appointment of brandie o'toole as meal site manager. seconded by clerk emkey. call for vote: four- aye. the motion passed unanimously (4-0-0).

votes.motion: Ratify the Town Manager's appointment of Joseph Davis as Intermittent Heavy Equipment Operator
votes.quote: motion by chair nuzzolo to ratify the town manager's appointment of joseph davis as intermittent heavy equipment operator. seconded by clerk emkey. call for vote: four- aye. the motion passed unanimously (4-0-0).

votes.motion: Approve annual license renewals as printed on agenda with contingent votes for Bad Larry's, Blue Sky Golf, Dippin Donuts, Lunenburg Diner, Lunenburg Gas, Whalom Gas, and Baker's Towing, and standard approval for all others including Smokestack Roasters and Ixtapa's alcoholic beverage license
votes.quote: motion by chair nuzzolo to approve the annual license renewals as printed on the agenda, with contingent votes for bad larry's, blue sky golf, dippin donuts, lunenburg diner, lunenburg gas, whalom gas, and baker's towing, contingent upon resolution of the outstanding matters identified for each applicant, and with the standard approval (non-contingent) for all other applicants including smokestack roasters and ixtapa's alcoholic beverage license. seconded by clerk emkey. call for vote: four- aye. the motion passed unanimously (4-0-0).

votes.motion: Approve the annual Common Victualler license renewal for Red Pepper, Inc., d/b/a Ixtapa, 308 Massachusetts Avenue
votes.quote: motion by chair nuzzolo to approve the annual common victualler license renewal for red pepper, inc., d/b/a ixtapa, 308 massachusetts avenue. seconded by clerk emkey. call for vote: four- aye. the motion passed unanimously (4-0-0).

votes.motion: Approve the employment agreement for Karen Brochu as Interim Finance Director/Town Accountant
votes.quote: motion by chair nuzzolo to approve the employment agreement for karen brochu as interim finance director/town accountant. seconded by clerk emkey. call for vote: four- aye. the motion passed unanimously (4-0-0).

votes.motion: Approve the letter to Governor Maura Healey regarding local aid and the FY27 budget and send copies to the Governor, Lunenburg's state legislators, School Committee, and Finance Committee
votes.quote: motion by member lehtinen to approve the letter to governor maura healey regarding local aid and the fy27 budget and to send copies to the governor, lunenburg's state legislators, the school committee, and the finance committee. seconded by clerk emkey. call for vote: four- aye. the motion passed unanimously (4-0-0).
motion by clerk emkey to adjourn at 8:41 pm. seconded by member lehtinen. call for vote: four-aye. the motion passed (4-0-0).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: General Fund balance totaled $10.7 million with unassigned fund balance of $8.7 million, representing 18% of budget, up from 17% prior year
budget_items.quote: general fund balance totaled $10.7 million, with unassigned fund balance of $8.7 million, representing approximately 18% of the budget, up from 17% the prior year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town holds stabilization funds across multiple categories: General Stabilization, Vehicle and Equipment, Zoning, Health Insurance, and Opioid
budget_items.quote: stabilization funds included: general stabilization at $3.0 million (up ~$300k), vehicle and equipment stabilization at $2.3 million (up ~$400k), zoning stabilization at $243k, health insurance stabilization at $116k, and opioid stabilization at $184k.

budget_items.topic: FY24 Fund Balance Increase and Drivers
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fund balance increased by $651K driven by $653K revenue surplus and $1.5M expenditure savings, partially offset by $1.2M free cash used for budget
budget_items.quote: budgetary results showed a $651k increase in fund balance, driven by a $653k revenue surplus and $1.5 million in expenditures coming in under budget, partially offset by $1.2 million in free cash used to balance the fy24 budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Net OPEB liability decreased from $53.2M to $50.9M; OPEB trust reached $1.4M aided by $283K contribution and $141K investment income
